title: Middle Fullstack Developer (Node.js + React)
description:
Mirko Solutions is an international IT company specializing in web and mobile development for clients in the US, Canada, EU, and Australia. We deliver high-quality digital solutions including web applications, mobile apps, cloud systems, and custom software for businesses worldwide.

Due to the rapid growth of our company, we are currently looking for an experienced Middle Fullstack Developer (Node.js + React) to join our team and work on a new international project in our Tallinn office.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain scalable backend and frontend functionality
  • Build and integrate REST APIs and third-party services
  • Develop backend services using Node.js
  • Build and maintain frontend applications using React
  • Work with databases and complex business logic
  • Investigate and fix production and integration-related issues
    Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
  • Collaborate with QA, Team Leads, and other developers during feature delivery

 

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of commercial software development experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js
  • Solid experience with React
  • Good knowledge of TypeScript
  • Experience designing and integrating REST APIs
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Experience with Git and Docker
  • Understanding of CI/CD practices
  • Good understanding of software development principles and best practices
  • Good command of English
  • Ability to work from our Tallinn office

 

We offer:

  • Opportunity to work on an international project
  • Professional growth and development
  • Friendly and supportive team environment
  • Collaboration with experienced international teams
